# SOP-P3-L2-02 Product changeover - Ring Rolling line

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, EQ-P3-L2-HT03

Scope
This procedure defines the controlled steps required to perform a product changeover on the Ring Rolling line in P3-L2. It covers mechanical changeover, lubrication, heat-treat interface, safety preconditions, verification checks, and records to be kept. Refer to MM-P3-L2-RR02 for maintenance limits, SB-1041 for safety barriers, and SOP-P3-L2-01 for routine production startup.

Background and rationale
Changeovers on the Ring Rolling line require coordinated actions between the shear/blanking station (EQ-P3-L2-SB01), the radial ring rolling mill (EQ-P3-L2-RR02), and the heat-treat furnace (EQ-P3-L2-HT03). Proper sequencing prevents part damage, reduces downtime, and ensures metallurgical integrity. Key controls are tooling alignment, lubricant selection, and quench timing at the furnace. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930.

Preconditions (must be met before Step 1)
1. Production supervisor has approved changeover and logged the job in the shift board per SOP-P3-L2-01.
2. All affected operators and maintenance staff have read this SOP and the related maintenance document MM-P3-L2-RR02.
3. Safety barriers and lockout points as specified in SB-1041 are in place and verified.
4. Incoming material lot and part print are available and matched to the work order.

Personal protective equipment (PPE)
1. Mandatory: safety glasses, hearing protection, cut-resistant gloves, steel-toe footwear, and flame-resistant apron where heat exposure is expected.
2. Additional PPE specified by SB-1041 for tasks inside guarded zones.

Changeover steps (numbered sequence)
1. Stop production flow
   1.1. Notify line downstream and upstream about imminent stoppage.  
   1.2. Set conveyor and transfer controls to manual hold.  
   1.3. Verify zero parts in process between EQ-P3-L2-SB01 and EQ-P3-L2-HT03.

2. Lockout and isolation
   2.1. Apply lockout/tagout to electrical and pneumatic sources per SB-1041.  
   2.2. Verify isolation by attempting to actuate pertinent controls and confirming no motion.  
   2.3. Record lockout IDs in the changeover log.

3. Remove and inspect tooling
   3.1. Remove cutting and forming tools from EQ-P3-L2-SB01 and EQ-P3-L2-RR02 using the hoist and fixtures specified by MM-P3-L2-RR02.  
   3.2. Inspect tooling for wear and damage; measure against accepted wear limits in MM-P3-L2-RR02. If out of tolerance, tag tooling and initiate maintenance request.

4. Install new tooling and setup
   4.1. Install new or reconditioned tooling using the alignment fixtures.  
   4.2. Make mechanical alignment adjustments until visual and gauge checks align with the part datum. Rationale: precise alignment prevents eccentricity and reduces rework.  
   4.3. Tighten fasteners to the values specified on the tooling drawsheet (refer to MM-P3-L2-RR02).

5. Lubrication
   5.1. Confirm lubricant part number for EQ-P3-L2-RR02. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling radial ring rolling mill #2 (EQ-P3-L2-RR02) is CFW-LUB-930.  
   5.2. Fill reservoirs and prime delivery lines following the pump-priming checklist.  
   5.3. Record lubricant batch and fill volume in the maintenance log.

6. Heat-treat interface and quench configuration
   6.1. Verify furnace recipe and quench system settings for the new part. Rationale: quench timing directly affects microstructure and dimensional stability.  
   6.2. Confirm the quench delay maximum for EQ-P3-L2-HT03. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #3 (EQ-P3-L2-HT03) is 13 seconds.  
   6.3. Validate quench actuation and interlocks with dry-run (no load) per MM-P3-L2-RR02.

7. Dry-run and trial parts
   7.1. Run a dry-cycle through EQ-P3-L2-SB01, EQ-P3-L2-RR02, and EQ-P3-L2-HT03 with safeguards engaged.  
   7.2. Produce trial parts and perform dimensional and metallurgical inspections as specified on the work order. Example: check ring inside diameter at the datum face and verify hardness profile per the part print.  
   7.3. If trial parts pass acceptance, authorize production ramp-up.

8. Production ramp-up
   8.1. Incrementally return controls to automatic and monitor first production pieces.  
   8.2. Maintain increased quality sampling frequency during first production run and record results.

9. Recordkeeping and documentation
   9.1. Complete the changeover checklist and attach trial part inspection results.  
   9.2. Enter lubricant batch, tooling IDs, lockout IDs, and furnace recipe ID into the electronic changeover record.  
   9.3. File the changeover record under the work order and reference MM-P3-L2-RR02 and SB-1041 where applicable.

Examples and common failure modes
1. Example: misaligned tooling resulting in increased scrap. Mitigation: verify alignment per Step 4.2 and re-check after first 10 pieces.  
2. Example: delayed quench leading to soft spots. Mitigation: confirm the quench delay maximum for EQ-P3-L2-HT03 and monitor furnace interlocks during dry-run.

Verification and acceptance criteria
1. Trial parts meet dimensional and hardness acceptance criteria on the inspection sheet.  
2. No safety barrier bypass or unresolved lockout remains in place.  
3. Changeover log and electronic records are complete and signed.

Sign-off
1. Production Supervisor: print name, signature, and time in the changeover log.  
2. Maintenance Lead: confirm tooling and lubrication installation and sign the maintenance portion of the record.  
3. Quality Inspector: confirm trial part acceptance and sign the inspection report.

Related documents
- MM-P3-L2-RR02  
- SB-1041  
- SOP-P3-L2-01

Records to keep
1. Changeover checklist and electronic changeover record.  
2. Trial part inspection reports and hardness trace.  
3. Lubricant batch and tooling ID records.  
4. Lockout/tagout record per SB-1041.

Revision history and control
All changes to this document must be submitted through the document control process and reference MM-P3-L2-RR02 for any tooling or maintenance updates.
